{{Recipe summary
| Category = Seafood recipes
| Servings = 4–8
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] shucked large [[Cookbook:Oyster|oysters]], cleaned and dried
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* 2 cups fine [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]] or [[Cookbook:Cracker|cracker]] crumbs
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|Cayenne pepper]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]], to fry
==Procedure==
# Take the cleaned oysters, place them on a clean towel, and dry them.
# Beat the eggs and cream together, and place in a shallow bowl. 
# Combine the bread or cracker crumbs with the salt, pepper, and cayenne. Place in a shallow bowl or on a plate.
# With a fork, dip each oyster individually in the egg, then in the crumbs. With the back of a spoon, pat the crumbs to adhere them to the oysters.
# Heat the oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]—the amount of oil will vary with the cooking method used.
# [[Cookbook:Deep frying|Deep fry]], [[Cookbook:Pan frying|pan fry]], or [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] the oysters in the pan, but do not crowd them; cook in batches if needed. Fry quickly until light brown on both sides; 1 or 2 minutes a side should be enough.
# Serve hot.
